temporal_split.tie_policy: all rows sharing a boundary timestamp remain in the earlier role
temporal_split.user_eligibility: at least 5 FIT_VISIBLE interactions before the query
temporal_split.query_policy: earliest eligible target event per user per protected role
temporal_split.candidate_availability: item first-observed interaction timestamp <= query timestamp
temporal_split.availability_disclosure: first-observed interaction time is a proxy, not a product launch timestamp

controlled_zero_support.eligible_items: items observed in the source FIT interval
controlled_zero_support.selection: sha256(protocol_id + ':controlled-zero:' + item_id) interpreted as uint256 < floor(0.05 * 2^256)
controlled_zero_support.withholding: remove all selected-item interactions from model-visible FIT collaboration

natural_zero_support.definition: target item has zero model-visible FIT interactions without protocol withholding
natural_zero_support.candidate_requirement: target is available under first-observed candidate semantics at query time

primary_question: Can a support-aware expert router preserve the content expert's zero-support cold-start advantage while switching rapidly enough to a sequence expert to avoid warm-quality collapse?

model_families.legacy: p1-style M1_T2 adapted to PixelRec p2

router_definitions.R1: content expert when FIT support == 0; sequence expert otherwise
router_definitions.R2: g(s)=sigmoid(a+b*log1p(s)), b=softplus(raw_b), with exact content-only override at s=0
router_definitions.R3: gate uses only log1p FIT support, age proxy, FIT history length, FIT recency, historical popularity/tail share, and declared content indicators
router_definitions.R4: R3 plus warm positive-support distillation against frozen C_seq logits and zero-support content learning

score_alignment.selection_metric: mean of controlled-zero NDCG@20 and margin-adjusted warm NDCG@20 after unit scaling
score_alignment.protected_rule: procedure and fitted parameters freeze before QUALIFICATION

hpo.early_stopping_metric: VALIDATION overall NDCG@20 with cold and warm gates reported
hpo.ensemble_policy: arithmetic mean of aligned full-catalog scores across all three independent seeds

locked_open_requires: complete E05 manifest committed and hashed

p1_immutability: p1 artifacts are read-only hypothesis provenance and never enter p2 canonical receipt counts
